label: Victron Storm Watch
info:
Storm watch automation for Victron Cerbo GX.

Reads CAP alerts + GPS, then raises ESS Min SoC and sets Keep Batteries Charged during active in-zone storm alerts.
Restores baseline when alerts clear.

name: Init config into flow context
Build CAP request
Parse CAP feed
Store GPS + portalId
Track baseline MinSoC / Hub4
Evaluate storm state & create commands
